description: Source code implementing tree comparison, matching, and manipulation functions for a version control system, likely Git, including scoring trees, matching subtrees, and splicing trees.

methods.name: score_missing
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty based on the file mode if a tree entry is missing.

methods.name: score_differs
methods.description: Calculates a score penalty when two tree entries differ in mode.

methods.name: score_matches
methods.description: Calculates a score for matching tree entries, with special handling for directories and symlinks.

methods.name: fill_tree_desc_strict
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and initializes a tree descriptor.

methods.name: score_trees
methods.description: Compares two trees and returns a similarity score based on their entries.

methods.name: match_trees
methods.description: Recursively matches subtrees to find the best match and score.

methods.name: splice_tree
methods.description: Replaces a subtree at a given prefix in one tree with another tree.

methods.name: shift_tree
methods.description: Attempts to shift a tree's structure to resemble another by prefixing or unprefixing subtrees.

methods.name: shift_tree_by
methods.description: Shifts a tree structure by a specified prefix, either adding or removing the prefix to match another tree.
